_about: Real OPAX pages used in "See it in OPAX". Each was fetched once with a read-only GET; status is the HTTP result.

examples.label: Sport Legislation Amendment (World Anti-Doping Code Implementation) Bill 2026
examples.look_at: The stages recorded so far: introduced and second reading moved in the House on 17 Sep 2026; before parliament as at that date.

examples.label: Senate refers veterans' health treatment limits to a committee (17 Sep 2026)
examples.look_at: An inquiry into an issue, not a bill. The question names the matter, the committee and the 8 March 2027 reporting date. Agreed 34 to 21.

examples.label: Water Amendment (Restoring Our Rivers) Bill 2023
examples.look_at: Senate committee-stage divisions, then the House agreeing to the Senate amendments on 30 Nov 2023, then royal assent on 7 Dec 2023.

examples.label: House agrees to the Senate amendments (30 Nov 2023)
examples.look_at: Agreed 86 to 53; the question explains the bill can now become law.

examples.label: Interactive Gambling Amendment (Gambling Reform) Bill 2026, third reading (18 Aug 2026)
examples.look_at: How each party voted: Labor and Liberals aye; the 10 independents no.

examples.label: Criminal Code Amendment (Hate Crimes) Bill 2024, Senate third reading (6 Feb 2025)
examples.look_at: Passed 41 to 6. One Liberal senator voted no while the other 8 voted aye.

examples.label: Restoring Territory Rights Bill 2022, House third reading (3 Aug 2022)
examples.look_at: Passed 99 to 38 ("affirmative" means the bill passed). Liberal 13 aye, 17 no; Labor 69 aye, 5 no; Nationals 5 aye, 8 no.
